overview_description.description: 1stCollab is a network that connects brands and creators. 1stCollab is creating world-class discovery experiences to assist brands in finding the ideal creator for their upcoming influencer marketing campaigns, as well as to assist creators in finding relevant campaigns to which they can apply. 1stCollab will enable brands to run higher performing influencer campaigns with less effort by being the first influencer marketing platform that prioritises discovery and recommendations.
